host.title: Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the SAP HANA server.

port.title: Port
port.description: SQL port of the SAP HANA instance (3<instance>15 for single-tenant / SYSTEMDB, 3<instance>41+ for tenant databases).

database_name.title: Tenant Database Name
database_name.description: Optional. Name of the tenant database to connect to on a multi-tenant (MDC) system when connecting through the SYSTEMDB port.

username.title: Username
username.description: Database user. It needs SELECT privileges on the replicated tables and read access to the SYS catalog views.

schemas.title: Schemas
schemas.description: Schemas to discover tables from (e.g. SAPHANADB). Names are case-sensitive.

table_name_patterns.title: Table Name Patterns
table_name_patterns.description: Optional list of SQL LIKE patterns restricting which tables/views are discovered (e.g. ACDOCA, CSK%, MAR_). SAP ERP schemas contain 100k+ tables, so restricting discovery is strongly recommended.

stream_settings.title: Stream Settings
stream_settings.description: Optional per-table settings. Use SCHEMA.TABLE to target a single schema; a bare TABLE applies to every schema.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Table or view name, optionally schema-qualified (SCHEMA.TABLE).

condition.title: Row Filter (SQL)
condition.description: Boolean SAP HANA SQL expression inserted as WHERE (condition) in every sync mode. ';' is not allowed.

cursor_field.title: Default Cursor Field
cursor_field.description: Column proposed as incremental cursor, and used when a client requests incremental without choosing one.

primary_key.title: Primary Key Override
primary_key.description: Columns identifying a row, for tables without a primary key constraint in the catalog (e.g. ACDOCA). Enables dedup and resumable full refresh. The columns must be unique together.

include_views.title: Include Views
include_views.description: Also expose views (including calculation views published as SQL views) as streams.

encrypt.title: Encrypt Connection (TLS)
encrypt.description: Encrypt the connection using TLS. Required for SAP HANA Cloud.

ssl_validate_certificate.title: Validate Server Certificate
ssl_validate_certificate.description: Validate the server TLS certificate. Only used when encryption is enabled.

ssl_trust_store.title: Trust Store (PEM)
ssl_trust_store.description: Optional PEM-encoded CA certificate(s) used to validate the server certificate.

compress.title: Compress Network Traffic
compress.description: Enable SAP HANA protocol compression. Typically doubles throughput over VPN/WAN links at the cost of some HANA CPU; disable it on fast local networks if HANA CPU is the bottleneck.

connection_properties.title: Additional Connection Properties
connection_properties.description: Additional hdbcli connection properties as key=value pairs separated by ';' (e.g. 'communicationTimeout=0;reconnect=TRUE').

tunnel_method.title: SSH Tunnel Method
tunnel_method.description: Whether to initiate an SSH tunnel before connecting to the database, and if so, which kind of authentication to use.
No ssh tunnel needed to connect to database
Connect through a jump server tunnel host using username and ssh key

tunnel_host.title: SSH Tunnel Jump Server Host
tunnel_host.description: Hostname of the jump server host that allows inbound ssh tunnel.

tunnel_port.title: SSH Connection Port
tunnel_port.description: Port on the proxy/jump server that accepts inbound ssh connections.

tunnel_user.title: SSH Login Username
tunnel_user.description: OS-level username for logging into the jump server host.

ssh_key.title: SSH Private Key
ssh_key.description: OS-level user account ssh key credentials in RSA PEM format ( created with ssh-keygen -t rsa -m PEM -f myuser_rsa ). Ed25519 and ECDSA keys are also supported.

tunnel_method.description: Connect through a jump server tunnel host using username and password authentication

tunnel_host.title: SSH Tunnel Jump Server Host
tunnel_host.description: Hostname of the jump server host that allows inbound ssh tunnel.

tunnel_port.title: SSH Connection Port
tunnel_port.description: Port on the proxy/jump server that accepts inbound ssh connections.

tunnel_user.title: SSH Login Username
tunnel_user.description: OS-level username for logging into the jump server host

tunnel_user_password.title: Password
tunnel_user_password.description: OS-level password for logging into the jump server host

fetch_size.title: Fetch Size
fetch_size.description: Number of rows fetched from HANA per round-trip. Rows are streamed, never fully loaded in memory.

resumable_full_refresh.title: Resumable Full Refresh
resumable_full_refresh.description: For tables with a primary key, read full refreshes in pages ordered by the primary key and checkpoint after every page, so an interrupted sync resumes where it stopped instead of starting over. Tables without a primary key are always read with a single query.

full_refresh_page_size.title: Full Refresh Page Size
full_refresh_page_size.description: Rows per page in resumable full refresh.

max_concurrent_streams.title: Max Concurrent Streams
max_concurrent_streams.description: Number of streams read in parallel, each on its own HANA connection. Keep 1 on systems that struggle under load; 2-4 usually speeds up syncs of many tables.

checkpoint_interval.title: Checkpoint Interval
checkpoint_interval.description: Minimum number of records between two state checkpoints in incremental syncs.

max_retries.title: Max Retries
max_retries.description: How many times to reconnect after a lost connection before failing a stream. Incremental streams resume from the last checkpointed cursor value.

retry_wait_seconds.title: Retry Wait (seconds)
retry_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before reconnecting after a lost connection.

decimal_handling.title: Decimal Handling
decimal_handling.description: How DECIMAL / SMALLDECIMAL values are emitted. 'number' is the most convenient; 'string' preserves full precision for values with more than 15 significant digits.

strip_nul_characters.title: Strip NUL Characters
strip_nul_characters.description: Remove NUL (0x00) characters from string values. SAP text tables (e.g. MAKT) occasionally contain them and most destinations (e.g. PostgreSQL) reject them.
